in_marathi.name: Saban
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saban हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saban is a Hindi name for the goddess Shakti, who is the embodiment of strength and protection. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shakti', which means power.

in_bengali.name: Saban
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of strength
in_bengali.long_meaning: Saban একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Saban is a Hindi name for the goddess Shakti, who is the embodiment of strength and protection. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shakti', which means power.
